mapper.update: UPDATE notifications SET is_read = 1 WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND is_read = 0
mapper.select: SELECT target_price_enabled, volatility_enabled, volatility_threshold, dividend_enabled, news_enabled FROM notification_settings WHERE user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO notification_settings (user_id, target_price_enabled, volatility_enabled, volatility_threshold, dividend_enabled, news_enabled) VALUES (#{userId}, #{form.targetPriceEnabled}, #{form.volatilityEnabled}, #{form.volatilityThreshold}, #{form.dividendEnabled}, #{form.newsEnabled}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE target_price_enabled = VALUES(target_price_enabled), volatility_enabled = VALUES(volatility_enabled), volatility_threshold = VALUES(volatility_threshold), dividend_enabled = VALUES(dividend_enabled), news_enabled = VALUES(news_enabled)
INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, type, symbol, title, body, link_url) VALUES (#{userId}, #{type}, #{symbol}, #{title}, #{body}, #{linkUrl})
mapper.select: SELECT h.user_id, h.symbol, tp.target_price, dp.high AS today_high FROM holdings h JOIN (SELECT t.user_id, t.symbol, t.target_price FROM transactions t JOIN (SELECT user_id, symbol, MAX(id) AS max_id FROM transactions WHERE target_price IS NOT NULL AND deleted_at IS NULL GROUP BY user_id, symbol) last ON last.max_id = t.id) tp ON tp.user_id = h.user_id AND tp.symbol = h.symbol JOIN daily_prices dp ON dp.symbol = h.symbol AND dp.trade_date = #{tradeDate} JOIN daily_prices prev ON prev.symbol = h.symbol AND prev.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(p2.trade_date) FROM daily_prices p2 WHERE p2.symbol = h.symbol AND p2.trade_date < #{tradeDate}) LEFT JOIN notification_settings ns ON ns.user_id = h.user_id WHERE h.quantity > 0 AND COALESCE(ns.target_price_enabled, 1) = 1 AND prev.high < tp.target_price AND dp.high >= tp.target_price AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notifications n WHERE n.user_id = h.user_id AND n.symbol = h.symbol AND n.type = 'TARGET_PRICE' AND n.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE)

SELECT h.user_id, h.symbol, prev.close AS prev_close, dp.close AS today_close, dp.close / prev.close - 1 AS change_rate FROM holdings h JOIN daily_prices dp ON dp.symbol = h.symbol AND dp.trade_date = #{tradeDate} JOIN daily_prices prev ON prev.symbol = h.symbol AND prev.trade_date = (SELECT MAX(p2.trade_date) FROM daily_prices p2 WHERE p2.symbol = h.symbol AND p2.trade_date < #{tradeDate}) LEFT JOIN notification_settings ns ON ns.user_id = h.user_id WHERE h.quantity > 0 AND COALESCE(ns.volatility_enabled, 1) = 1 AND prev.close > 0 AND ABS(dp.close / prev.close - 1) >= COALESCE(ns.volatility_threshold, 0.05) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notifications n WHERE n.user_id = h.user_id AND n.symbol = h.symbol AND n.type = 'VOLATILITY' AND n.created_at >= CURRENT_DATE)
